posts.cooked:
Oh hey, the quote functionality seems to have improved?!..  Except I don't seem to be able to un-italicize text.  Odd.

I was considering inserting some flavor into my posts, but ended up getting carried away and writing the beginnings of a little fanfiction piece based on this matchup (well, the Wraith vs. Spite on Mars part of it, I'm not committed to using the same heroes apart from the villain's nemesis).  I love Dark Visionary's line, I might throw a similar one-liner in if I can think of one at some point, but for now I'll stay on-task.

The Wraith

HP: 24

Hand: Grappling Hook, Infrared Eyepiece, Micro-Targeting Computer, Utility Belt.

In play:

Trash:

Additional effects:

Start of hero turn:

Play a card: Infrared Eyepiece

Use a power: Stealth. Reduce the next damage that would be dealt to the Wraith by 2.

Draw a card: Combat Stance (oh, wouldn't that have been nice to have had a moment ago!)

End of hero turn:

HP: 24

Hand: Grappling Hook, Micro-Targeting Computer, Utility Belt, Combat Stance.

In play: Infrared Eyepiece

Trash:

Additional effects:   Wraith is Spite's nemesis (+1 damage dealt and received).  Next instance of damage reduced by 2.

Not being sure exactly what Turmoil did, I wasn't sure whether to activate IR Eyepiece this turn, but ultimately decided against it just based on my taking double damage from Demon's Kiss; until I get Utility Belt down, I feel like a half-redundant contribution to Visionary's one-man "just say YES to drugs" initiative was less important than protecting myself.  If Wraith should somehow chance to be tied with 1+ other heroes for highest HP at the start of the end of the next villain turn (or earlier if a card is played to such effect), I give the other players permission to select Wraith to take the 3 damage (and reduce Spite's healing by a net of 1) if they deem it tactically correct (I find this to be improbable, but I won't have time to post like at all tomorrow, so I put the decision in your hands).  Otherwise, I'd much rather let someone else take 4 damage, then have Stealth entirely prevent the nemesis-boosted Demon's Kiss damage to me.

If nothing drastic happens during the non-hero turns, you can safely assume that my next turn will involve playing Utility Belt and using both powers.  I concur with the general "get him drunkgged" plan, and you may resolve the Eyepiece's effects at your discretion in order to avoid delaying the game.  I should be back to posting sometime past midnight on Saturday morning, or else I'll find time at least once during the day.

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Today was less busy than I feared.  And yes, if there was a change to quote functionality yesterday, it was quickly undone.  TLT draw:  Suture Self.

"Okay people, we know that the killer only strikes at night, so you've got six hours to make this place impregnable.  You there, get some bars on that window, the glass is only four inches thick, that won't hold unless he's feeling lazy.  Over there; I can see stress micro-fractures in that paneling, start layering on the concrete.  Remember, nobody opens that door without a password!"  Her left eye gleaming red, the Wraith might have looked menacing, but the man and the two little girls had Haka's and Visionary's word that she was there to protect them, however overbearing she was about it.  Not normally in-character for Maia, but the presence of one of her worst adversaries in this outre new locale had rattled her severely, and she was overcompensating.  A body count of one was one too many, that poor aid worker; the station's population was only in the dozens of dozens, that meant not a single pair of hands could be spared.  She might have to boss a few innocents around rudely, but she would ensure they lived to complain about it.

The Wraith

HP: 24

Hand: Grappling Hook, Infrared Eyepiece, Micro-Targeting Computer, Utility Belt, Suture Self.

In play:

Trash:

Additional effects:

Start of hero turn:

Play a card: Utility Belt

Use powers: Infrared Eyepiece.  Draw Mega Computer.  (It has video games on it, so let me know when a Bystander stands by.)

Stealth. Reduce the next damage that would be dealt to the Wraith by 2.

Draw a card: Smoke Bombs

End of hero turn:

HP: 24

Hand: Grappling Hook, Micro-Targeting Computer, Combat Stance, Suture Self, Mega Computer, Smoke Bombs.

In play: Infrared Eyepiece, Utility Belt

Trash:

Additional effects:  Wraith is Spite's nemesis (+1 damage dealt and received).  Next instance of damage reduced by 2.  Reveal the top two cards of the villain deck and put one (almost certainly Forced Entry) on the bottom.

Unity, I don't think you need to skip your turn; you've got all those cards in hand and could start cranking out Bots.  (Please use the Modular Workbench, I don't want to give up any Equipment anytime soon.)  I can easily play the Grappling Hook on my next turn to get rid of the Countdown; it'll let me add to my already ridiculous hand size.

Tachyon, you have permission to slap me (Nimble Strike) so that I am no longer highest HP, and then Unity or Visionary's decoy can take the hit from Spite so it isn't increased by 1.  If you want to.  (I'm sure the temptation has occurred to you.)  Nevermind, I forgot I was Stealthing again.  Looks like Spite gets to be my harshest critic, but I can take it.  Almost decided to play Combat Stance instead, just so I could belt out a cutting remark in exchange, but I forgot there was still little point in trying to deal damage to him, so we'll stick to defense mode.
